summary: Proof converges Change 1 to a minimal product boundary: reuse the accepted Action exact-operation pattern without importing Action lifecycle. A closed five-value DeliveryOperationId set, deterministic skills/delivery/** mapping, content-bound DeliveryGuidanceRef, and one stable DeliveryOperationPackage envelope over trusted operation-specific facts are sufficient. Change 1 needs only the concrete Delivery Start facts/HOW; later D04 Changes add their own fact validators/HOW. No Registry, Router, Planner, second Delivery lifecycle, Agent Skill discovery layer or automatic Git authority is justified.
specDelta: NEW bounded Delivery-operation execution/start-continuity capability; exact Proposal capability path to be materialized in Proposal
durableFacts: Pre-Explore continuity against exact Delivery Start fixed point eaa1c8f1 passed before Change mutation; no prior D04 Start drift was found.
Owner-authorized Memo pre-explore-repository-fixed-point-continuity-check is open and non-blocking; its future target is .agents Action/Explore bootstrap, not D04 product skills/delivery scope.
ProjectOrdinal 026 was assigned exactly once from unique durable manifest ordinals 021..025 after trusted coordination and Policy proved Explore legal/current.
Accepted Action Guidance/ActionPackage/single-Action seams pass 68/68 focused tests and provide the proven exact-operation/content-bound-Guidance/package pattern.
There is no pre-existing product DeliveryOperation implementation or skills/delivery surface; Change 1 is a bounded new execution seam.

A non-production prototype proves all five planned Delivery operation mappings are static, unknown ids fail closed, Guidance byte drift changes identity, wrong Guidance/authority rejects package formation, and symlink Guidance fails closed.

DeliveryOperationPackage should bind deliveryId, already-decided operationId, exact OwnerAuthorityFact/null, trusted operation-specific facts, and exact DeliveryGuidanceRef; it must not copy CurrentAction prepared/terminal lifecycle semantics.
Delivery Start is the first concrete operation facts/HOW variant; later D04 Changes extend operation-specific validated facts without creating dynamic discovery or a new control plane.
D04 continues through independent .agents bootstrap and must not self-host on candidate skills/delivery or DeliveryOperationPackage during its own acceptance.
explicitNonGoals: Skill/Guidance Registry, Router, Planner or dynamic discovery/ranking
